The '''Situation Rooms''',<ref name="FOTJA" /> also known as the '''Headquarters of the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]]''',<ref name="OP1">[[Star Wars (1998) 7|''Star Wars'' (1998) 7]]</ref> were data and planning centers located in each of the four Council Spires of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="SWCL" />

==History==
The Situation Rooms of the Jedi Temple were located in each of the four Jedi Council towers and served as the Headquarters of the four Jedi Councils.<ref name="OP1" /> Built circa [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], each was constantly connected to the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] and made use of the massive communications receiver suspended above the chamber to keep the Order in touch with every planet in the Republic, as well as Jedi serving in the field. Datafeeds ran to the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] and the [[Jedi Temple communication center/Legends|communication center]] to allow the members of the Council to pull of datasheets and records at an instant's notice.<ref name="SWCL" />

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] some members of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] met in the Situation Room to review the history of [[Sharad Hett]], a revered [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who may be connected to a [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken]] uprising on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. After analyzing footage sent from the backwater world, [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and Master [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]] send newly appointed Council member [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] to discover the truth behind these startling accusations.<ref name="OP1" />

Soon after the failed arrest of the Sith Lord and Jedi Skywalker's fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]], the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] was ordered to execute [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]] under Executive [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. Led by Skywalker, now [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] marched into the Temple and began the slaughter of its occupants. During the mayhem, the Situation Room's inevitably sustained damage and were left in ruin as the Temple burned. Abandoned throughout the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], the Temple stood for several decades until it was retaken by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Briefly reoccupied by the [[New Jedi Order]], the few Jedi under the tutelage of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] searched the Temple for any information they could find on the Jedi of old. The Towers of the Temple would collapse during the catastrophe with the ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'' and were cleared away, their places filled with a new [[Jedi Headquarters|enclave]] that served as a diplomatic way-point and a training ground for new Jedi away from the [[Jedi Praxeum]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="DTII">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]''</ref>

While the Temple itself was destroyed during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the victorious [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] donated a [[New Jedi Temple|new Temple]] through the [[Reconstruction Authority]].<ref name="Dark Nest I: The Joiner King">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref> While the Temple's spires were rebuilt as they had stood for over a millennia, they were concealed within a large [[Duracrete/Legends|duracrete]] and [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] pyramid. The Situation Rooms were updated with new technology and served in much the same capacity as they had for the larger half of the Temple's history.<ref name="FOTJA" />

==Layout==
Accessed by [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] and a set of ancient stairs, the lift car was the designated lift for the Council Chambers at the top of the spire and for the offices of the Council members.<ref name="FOTJA" />

The chamber was located behind a set of blast doors. Equipped with state of the art tactical displays and [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] feeds, the Situation Rooms were said to rival the comm stations of most flagships.<ref name="FOTJA" /> With a direct hook up to the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] and the [[Jedi Temple communication center/Legends|communication center]], the Jedi Council was always apprised of new information constantly pouring into the Temple.<ref name="SWCL" />
